en.html:
Kanae"Mm, what a lovely taste. The stock is so well drawn... mm, I simply cannot resist. And this dressed greens dish is lovely too."
ふき"Sorry... that we can only serve such poor things."
Kanae"Nahin, nahin. Fresh vegetables and mountain greens, rice cooked at exactly the right moment, handmade miso..."
Kanae"These are the very things that make the best feast. Isn't that so, Sayo?"
Sayo"Entirely, Miss."

en.html:
The household's population had risen by fifty percent. A brief round of introductions, and then straight on to dinner.

...Nothing else was discussed. Not by me, not by Elder Yagenta, not by the two who had come. It was not needed now.

Kanae Ootori ate with obvious pleasure, pickles laid over a rice that was half barley. A very healthy appetite.
